notes.title: SPRAWL FOR CONSOLES HAS ARRIVED! + NEW PC UPDATE VERSION 1.5.1
notes.content:
We’ve been listening and working diligently, and we’re super happy to announce that SPRAWL is now out on Playstation 5, and Xbox Series consoles! Check out the trailer below:

[previewyoutube=6Md4MwR6SmU;full][/previewyoutube]

Not only that but we’ve just launched a massive QOL update that fixes numerous bugs, adds some requested community features as well as increasing the amount of languages SPRAWL supports to 10! This means that there’s never been a better time to give the game another go or to hop in for the first time. These include:


[list]
[*] Button prompts now display on tutorials and switches across keyboard and controller.
[*] Players now respawn with a minimum of 4 pistol shots to help get back on their feet without relying on melee.
[*] Respawn now includes 4 seconds of invulnerability.
[*] Fixed an issue with hitstun on various enemies.
[*] Addressed enemy navigation issues across levels in the game.
[*] Fixed music looping issues on all race maps.
[*] Resolved an issue with Codex navigation.
[*] Fixed issues with Codex labeling.
[*] Various fixes to all localizations.
[*] Improved setting sliders functionality for gamepad users.
[*] Added additional languages with proper font fallbacks.
[/list]

And many more!

And if you haven't yet, please give us some love and review the game!

We’ve got a lot more planned in the future, so stay tuned and join our discord for official updates or if you just want to chat with the developers, we’re always around to answer any questions!

[url=https://discord.gg/4kVen5XDfn]Discord[/url]

P.S. Keep those clips coming on Discord and X/Twitter (@SprawlFPS), and throw in a tag for our publisher (@rogue_co) so they can join the fun too. Cheers! 🙌

notes.title: ONE YEAR OF SPRAWL! HAPPY BIRTHDAY! WHO WANTS SOME FREE STUFF?
notes.content:
I can’t believe I’m saying this, but it's officially been a year since SPRAWL was released! Since then our community has only grown. The reception to the game has been beyond our wildest dreams with us currently sitting at nearly 1600 reviews, and a very positive review score. We couldn’t have done it without all of you sharing and playing the game. [b]We love games, and we love you all.[/b]

So what's next?

Well we’ve got a couple of surprises in store for you for our first birthday, the first of which is a formal announcement. [b]SPRAWL is coming to PS5 and Xbox Series X/S[/b], and it’s coming very very soon. We’re putting together the finishing touches as we speak, with this release will come a much needed QOL update to the base game with some hotly anticipated community requests. We’ll have more details on this in the coming weeks.

But that's not all!

We went ahead and did something crazy. We’d like to announce SPRAWL 96. Check out the trailer 
here:

[previewyoutube=XzOye97fWz0;full][/previewyoutube]

SPRAWL 96 is a celebration of SPRAWL. It’s also our way of giving thanks and giving back to the communities which made SPRAWL possible. SPRAWL would be nothing without the Quake Mapping community, SPRAWL was originally built on Darkplaces, and the resources provided by nearly 30 years of dedicated modders made it possible to get it started. Hannah and myself, Carlos (REVEL), met on the Quake mapping discord, and well, the rest is as you say, history. Here we are 4 years later paying homage to our roots. 

So what actually is it? Well it's a revival in a sense of that original Quake engine version of SPRAWL. It answers the question “What if SPRAWL actually existed in 1996?”. So it includes every single SPRAWL weapon (sorta), a big portion of our enemy roster, and our movement mechanics all on a custom fork of the Ironwail Quake source port. It’s a near total conversion gameplay mod focused on vanilla entities setup, so all non-mod specific maps (non-copper, non-ad, non quoth etc) can be played. So long as you own Quake, you can play SPRAWL 96. For the modding community as a whole, we are also allowing you to use any of the assets created for SPRAWL 96 directly in your own non commercial mods. Careful set up has been taken in particular to the enemies models to make them vanilla compatible. Same frame data as vanilla monsters! We’ve also included a texture wad full of textures directly taken from SPRAWL, as well a prefab.map file which includes set ups for most of these assets, again free to use in your own non commercial mods. There are over 400 models, sounds, textures provided! Plenty of which is archival from the 2020 QuakeSprawl version of the game. 

So long story short, you got a copy of Quake? You can head over to our discord and download SPRAWL 96 for free right now and get playing.

[url=https://discord.gg/4kVen5XDfn]https://discord.gg/4kVen5XDfn[/url]

We got one more thing as well! 

Since the release of SPRAWL last year, we've added two new game modes, time trials and horde, and alongside them some new music has crept into the game. There's been an overwhelming amount of people asking for it, so I've taken the time to clean these up and get them ready for release. You can grab them exclusively on Bandcamp for the time being. I'll probably keep it this way, but we'll see what happens!

[url=https://revel303.bandcamp.com/album/sprawl-bonus-tracks-bandcamp-exclusive]https://revel303.bandcamp.com/album/sprawl-bonus-tracks-bandcamp-exclusive[/url]

Alongside those songs I've included a whole gamut of scraps that didn't make the final OST, this includes early versions of some songs, as well as tracks I was writing while trying to figure out the general sound and texture for the game.

Oh I can't forget the full extended cut of Ghost Wetware!

So for those of you that have been asking for some more SPRAWL music, we’ve got you covered.


So that's it from us for now, but expect more news in the coming weeks, sorry if we kept you waiting! We had to keep all this under wraps for the time being. There’s a lot more coming from us in the near future, so stay tuned! On a personal note, thank you all so much for all the support. I say this time and time again and it's because I mean it, we’re building something special here and we could not do it without you. I promise as long as I'm here I'm going to bust my ass for every single one of you. 

Thank you

- Carlos



P.S. And those clips you've been sending our way? Loving every second of it. Keep 'em coming on Discord and X/Twitter (@SprawlFPS), and throw in a tag for our publisher (@rogue_co) so they can join the fun too. Cheers! 🙌

notes.title: SPRAWL - CODEX, QOL Update + 50% Off!
notes.content:
Everyone! 

We’ve been hard at work bringing some new content, plus some heavily requested features and bug fixes into the game. Game dev for a team of two is tough, but we love you all and wanted to continue to iterate on the game. We read every piece of feedback and although we can’t get everything in at once, we’ve got some cool things to give you this time around. As always, for free, no DLC here!

The QR code logs are now LIVE and in game. You will now be able to view them from inside SPRAWL and have them saved for you to revisit later. With the same not so subtle stylistic reference you get when you view them with your phone. This has been a colossal effort from Hannah to get all 50 lore docs into the game, so some kudos are in order!

Thank you all again for being a part of this incredible community, all the love, support and kindness keeps us going. We couldn’t have built SPRAWL without you all. 

We’ve got some more things in store in the future, so keep an eye out for that!

PATCH NOTES:

[list]
[*] Added “Codex” into the game. Walking over a PDA with a QR code on it will automatically populate the “Codex” menu. 50 pieces of unique collectable lore are now accessible in game.
[*] Added Time Trial map “TIER 2 MOVEMENT (ADVANCED)”
[*] Added Time Trial map “SLINGSHOT (ADVANCED)”

[*] Fixed issue where prototype enemy would be stuck behind shield wall on E3M2
[*] Fixed issue with drops not triggering on prototype carrier enemy on E3M3
[*] Fixed collision issue on some walls in E2M2
[*] Fixed collision issue on some walls in E2M3
[/list]

notes.title: A massive "thanks" from all of us behind Sprawl! ❤️
notes.content:
Hey Sprawlers!

Everyone, thank you all so much for your support on our little project. When myself (Carlos) and Hannah started SPRAWL, we had no idea we’d end up here. We’re not a giant studio, or even a small studio, it’s just the two of us trying to put together our first game. It’s been an honor to see all the love and support from the community and fans that have cropped up, the conversations around the game, the setting, the story, seeing people love it. I wanted to take the moment to appreciate all of you for being a part of this journey. We’re still working hard bringing new features and content to the game, we read every message and every review. It’s important to us as we continue to work on this game together with you all. ːsteamhappyː

[h3]And if you havent yet, please leave a review! This really helps us! Let's get to 1000![/h3]

Before I get into the next part, I want to take the time to give my appreciation to the speedrunning community and Games Done Quick, as well as Humble Bundle for allowing us to participate in this year's AGDQ with BloodThunder running SPRAWL, and beating it in 23 minutes! My family has been deeply affected by cancer, taking many people close to us, having the opportunity to give back in some capacity to cancer research has been an incredible experience. Thank you all again.

We have a few QOL features we’re expecting to roll out over the next few months, a few nasty bugs we cannot for the life of us reproduce were trying to squash, and a major update for the most commonly requested feature.

The QR code logs are coming into the game. You will now be able to view them from inside SPRAWL and have them saved for you to revisit later. With the same on the nose styling you get from viewing them on the web.

But wait there is more! We can't talk much about it yet, but if you ever wanted to play SPRAWL on a couch, maybe without a PC... Hmm...

I keep saying it but I mean it. I’m so happy to be able to work on this game, thank you all so much for supporting us. ːsteamhappyː

You can watch BloodThunder’s run of SPRAWL here, with some commentary from myself (REVEL): 
[url=https://youtu.be/bh5TgV86B0k]Blood Thunder![/url]


Until next time! See ya in the SPRAWL.

notes.title: SPRAWL v1.2 - New Content, Features, Improvements.
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

We’ve been running all over the place getting this second update ready for you, and yes, it does include wall running tweaks and a HUD size adjustment. We promise we’ve been listening! This patch has a ton of adjustments so you can check the full list below, but we’re super excited to call out the new map modes we’ve added. Test your best time in the Time Trial maps and take on a massive wave of enemies in the Horde Mode. Think you’ve got what it takes? 

GENERAL:
[list]
[*] Added 3 new "Time Trial" maps.
[*] Added a "Horde Mode" map.
[*] Added crosshair option to gameplay settings.
[*] Added more fine grained difficulty options to settings menu.
[*] Reduced HUD scale.
[*] Removed max ammo count from HUD.
[/list]

MOVEMENT:
[list]
[*] Added third wall kick.
[*] Added options to adjust Wallrun Tilt and Strafe Tilt.
[*] Added wall stickiness slider.
[*] Increased baseline wall run "stickiness". It should now be easier to attach to walls.
[*] Increased base movement speed.
[*] Increased slide duration.
[*] Increased slide speed.
[*] Slide hopping now gives more distance and speed.
[*] Increased forward momentum gained from alternating walls.
[/list]

LEVELS:
[list]
[*] Final boss arena has been completely redesigned in order to give players an option to deal with the second round of turrets without firing a shot.
[*] Additional voice lines have been added in E3M1, E3M2, and E3M3 in order to provide context to the final boss fight which previously appeared in hidden codex entries.
[*] Several sections of E3M3 have been completely re-designed to give the player more options during combat.
[*] E3M2 has been updated with additional checkpoints.
[*] Two switches on E3M1 are now easier to hit.
[*] Keycard on E1M2 is now easier to pick up.
[*] Fixed hole in trigger on E1M1.
[*] Fixed (for realsies this time) final arena fight in E2M2 not triggering.
[/list]

WEAPON BALANCE:
[list]
[*] Headshot damage on pistols increased from 75 -> 100.
[*] Increased grenade launcher ammo cap from 6 to 8 grenades.
[*] Changed railgun ammo pickups from orange to blue to help differentiate them from grenades.
[*] Shotgun spread reduced from 3.0 to 2.5.
[*] Increased damage output of shotgun by .5 per pellet.
[*] Chaingun wind up speed increased by 0.3.
[*] Chaingun damage output increased by 10 per shot.
[/list]

ENEMY BALANCE:
[list]
[*] Ninja attack damage doubled from 10 - 20.
[*] Ninja walk speed increased from 1200 - 1300.
[*] Robot grunt run speed increased from 600 - 800.
[*] Shotgunner run speed increased from 600 - 740.
[*] Ogre movement speed increased by 20 units.
[*] Riot shield grunt movement speed increased from 600 - 700.
[*] Riot shield grunt health reduced from 100 - 80.
[*] Light mech class spectre will now properly ragdoll.
[*] Light mech class spectre is now easier to headshot.
[*] Light mech class spectre run speed increased from 600 - 800.
[*] Fixed bug with flying drones not hitting you if you stood perfectly still.
[/list]

A huge [b]thank you[/b] to this community! We truly appreciate everyone who has played the game, left a review, sent in feedback, etc. Please keep the comments coming! We’d love to see your amazing kill shots and runs so share your captures with us on Discord and X/Twitter (@SprawlFPS and tag our publisher so they can share them too @rogue_co).

notes.title: SPRAWL v1.1 - The Update that Saves Your Eardrums
notes.content:
First of all, we have to say a huge [b]thank you[/b] to everyone! It’s been an amazing first week seeing our game out in the wild and seeing people play it. Truly a dream come true for the two of us. We look forward to continuing to support the game.

We’ve seen the feedback and we’ve got you with our first set of fixes (yes including the fix to protect your eardrums!). 

We hope to address all the comments and concerns, and we promise you are heard and appreciated! Please bear with us over the next few weeks as the two of us continue to work as hard as we can on a multitude of other changes and fixes. More options coming soon, and more content!

HIGHLIGHTS:
[list]
[*] Fixed deafening sound on respawn!
[*] Removed scanlines from codex QR codes to make them easier to scan. (try using the Google Lens app if you are still facing issues, we are planning to bring these lore entries in-game in order to make the scanning optional. All achievements are obtainable simply by walking up to the golden PDAs).
[*] Tutorials have been re-written to be more descriptive.
[*] Fixed the “REAPER” boss respawning after death. 
[*] Added input buffering to weapon firing. 
[*] Allow people to bind the mouse wheel back to next/previous weapon. (bindings to other actions will be fixed in future updates). 
[*] Fixed some instances of the game crashing on respawn screen.
[/list]

OTHER CHANGES:
[list]
[*] Railgun charge speed increased by 25%.
[*] Alleviated some issues with inconsistent AI pathing in the arena on E1M4. 
[*] Fixed clipping into the boat on E1M5.
[*] Fixed issue where prototype enemy would be stuck behind shield wall on E3M1.
[*] Fixed issue where chaingun enemy pickups would not grant player ammo.
[*] Fixed issue with lift in E1M3 being able to leave without you if you clipped the trigger.
[*] Attempted fix with second arena in E2M2 not spawning enemies.
[*] Fixed players potentially being able to phase through a collider that pushes them on the waterfall section of E2M4.
[*] Gave players some more platforms to use on bossfight in E2M4.
[*] Increased ammo drops inside the boss arena in E2M4.
[*] Added teleporter triggers to GOR Complex tower climb (E2M4)
[*] Robot grunts have had their health cut from 300hp to 250hp.
[*] Robot grunts now drop double the amount of handgun ammo.
[*] Robot grunts' accuracy has been increased slightly.
[*] Robot grunts now ragdoll correctly.
[*] Berserkers have had their health reduced from 800hp to 700hp.
[*] Berserkers will now drop chaingun ammo when killed.
[*] Berserkers will now show damage to their body.
[*] Fixed controller navigation getting stuck on the "Apply" button in display settings. 
[*] Fixed broken visuals on the melee weapon when weapon bobbing is set to 0. 
[*] Light Mech Class Spectre has had its health reduced from 600 to 350 
[*] Some platforming in E3M3 has been made easier with additional platforms to land on.
[*] General changes to resource economy from weapon ammo drops on enemies has been rebalanced to make the later half of SPRAWL less reliant on weak point targeting.
[*] Some additional geometry has been added in the final arena in E3M1 to allow the player to easily target heads. 
[*] Fixed issue where the player could die before the elevator finishes leaving in E3M1.
[*] Fixed issue where the first arena in E2M1 would potentially soft lock.
[*] Voiceline that was previously untied to the volume slider has been corrected in E2M4 Bossfight.
[*] Hannah actually played the game this time. 
[/list]

NOTE: Other improvements around wall running are [b]in progress[/b]! It will take some time as we need to be careful not to break existing levels or movement tech but we are hard at work.
